short_title: Automated Vehicle Location (AVL) & Fleet Telematics Platform
additional_description: DCAS Fleet Services is seeking enterprise telematics software and OBD-II hardware deployment across 40,000 municipal vehicles. Solicitation establishes an M/WBE subcontracting goal of 30% under Local Law 1 and requires prevailing wage under NY Labor Law Section 220. Proposers must demonstrate 5 consecutive years of prior experience.

short_title: Urban Forestry Street Tree Planting and Maintenance
additional_description: Planting of balled and burlapped shade trees across Brooklyn and Queens Community Boards. Requires ISA Certified Arborist and minimum 3 years of commercial forestry experience. General liability insurance of $1,000,000.
